title: Stones floated in on reed boats and the pyramid site flooded

tellings.quote: built Reed boats uhhuh they actually harvested the stone uhhuh up the Nile

plain: The stones of the Egyptian pyramids at Giza were cut up the Nile, loaded onto reed boats and floated down, and the building site was flooded to bring them in. That is the account of Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, meaning someone who says he can see distant places and times with his mind, and he ties it to his book The Ultimate Time Machine. He gives it as his own finding, with no other source, and it would answer how the huge blocks were moved.
